# Scenario reference

Every built-in test case, generated from the code. How scenarios work and how to write your own: [Scenarios](../06-scenarios.md).

A step marked **1.6** is replaced on an OCPP 1.6 charger, and a step marked **only 2.0.1** / **only 1.6** is skipped on the other version. `$card` and `$card2` stand for the cards set on the charger.

**35 scenarios.** [Basics](#basics) · [Metering](#metering) · [Power & network](#power--network) · [Safety & electrical](#safety--electrical) · [Hardware](#hardware) · [Vehicle](#vehicle) · [Smart charging](#smart-charging) · [Bidirectional charging](#bidirectional-charging) · [Authorization](#authorization) · [Protocol](#protocol)

## Basics

### `smoke_boot`: Boot and connectors online

The station connects, is accepted by the CSMS and reports every connector Available.

| # | Step | Detail | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `do disconnect` | disconnect |  |
| 2 | `do connect` | connect |  |
| 3 | `expect online` | expect:online | waits up to 30 s |
| 4 | `expect response` | expect:response action=BootNotification, status=Accepted | waits up to 20 s |
| 5 | `expect connector_status` | expect:connector_status evse=1, status=Available |  |

### `rfid_session`: RFID charging session

Plug in, tap a card, charge for a few seconds, tap again to stop, unplug.

| # | Step | Detail | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `do plug_in` | plug_in evse=1, ev=large, soc=20 |  |
| 2 | `do tap` | tap evse=1, token=$card |  |
| 3 | `expect tx_state` | Charging starts | waits up to 20 s |
| 4 | `expect energy_gt` | Energy is flowing | waits up to 20 s |
| 5 | `do wait` | wait seconds=4 |  |
| 6 | `do tap` | tap |  |
| 7 | `expect tx_state` | Session ended |  |
| 8 | `expect message_sent` | CSMS received Ended (Local) | 1.6: CSMS received StopTransaction (Local); waits up to 30 s |
| 9 | `do unplug` | unplug |  |
| 10 | `expect connector_status` | expect:connector_status status=Available | waits up to 15 s |

| 5 | `do unplug` | unplug |  |

## Power & network

### `power_loss_session`: Power loss during a session

Power fails for 10 s while charging. On return the station boots (PowerUp) and closes the transaction with PowerLoss.

| # | Step | Detail | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `do plug_in` | plug_in evse=1, ev=large, soc=20 |  |
| 2 | `do tap` | tap evse=1, token=$card |  |
| 3 | `expect tx_state` | Charging starts | waits up to 20 s |
| 4 | `expect energy_gt` | Energy is flowing | waits up to 20 s |
| 5 | `do inject` | inject fault=power_loss, params={'duration_s': 10} |  |
| 6 | `expect online` | Station goes dark | waits up to 10 s |
| 7 | `expect online` | Power returns and the station boots | waits up to 40 s |
| 8 | `expect message_sent` | CSMS received Boot (PowerUp) after the outage | 1.6: CSMS received a Boot after the outage |
| 9 | `expect message_sent` | CSMS received Ended (PowerLoss) | 1.6: CSMS received StopTransaction (PowerLoss); waits up to 30 s |
| 10 | `do unplug` | unplug |  |

The idle station loses power for 8 s and comes back.

| # | Step | Detail | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `do inject` | inject fault=power_loss, params={'duration_s': 8} |  |

### `network_loss_session`: Network loss while charging (offline queue)

The WebSocket drops for 12 s while a session runs. Events are queued with offline=true and delivered in order afterwards.

| # | Step | Detail | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `do set_variable` | Report every 3 s so the outage queues events |  |
| 2 | `do plug_in` | plug_in evse=1, ev=large, soc=20 |  |
| 3 | `do tap` | tap evse=1, token=$card |  |
| 4 | `expect tx_state` | Charging starts | waits up to 20 s |
| 5 | `expect energy_gt` | Energy is flowing | waits up to 20 s |
| 6 | `do inject` | inject fault=network_loss, params={'duration_s': 12} |  |
| 7 | `expect queue_gte` | Events pile up offline | waits up to 20 s |
| 8 | `expect online` | Reconnected | waits up to 60 s |
| 9 | `expect queue_empty` | Queue delivered | waits up to 30 s |
| 10 | `expect message_sent` | CSMS received offline events | 1.6: CSMS received the queued MeterValues |
| 11 | `do tap` | tap |  |
| 12 | `do unplug` | unplug |  |

| 3 | `expect tx_state` | Charging starts | waits up to 20 s |
| 4 | `expect energy_gt` | Energy is flowing | waits up to 20 s |
| 5 | `do inject` | inject fault=grid_overload, params={'limit_kw': 4, 'duration_s': 20} |  |
| 6 | `expect message_sent` | expect:message_sent action=NotifyChargingLimit | only 2.0.1; waits up to 15 s |
| 7 | `expect message_sent` | expect:message_sent action=ClearedChargingLimit | only 2.0.1; waits up to 40 s |
| 8 | `do tap` | tap |  |
| 9 | `do unplug` | unplug |  |

## Bidirectional charging

### `v2g_discharge`: Vehicle-to-grid discharge

A bidirectional vehicle charges, then feeds 5 kW back to the grid: the export register and the session's export energy grow, and the vehicle's battery goes down. (Bidirectional vehicles: the mid-size and large EV.)

| # | Step | Detail | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `do set_variable` | Report the export register too |  |
| 2 | `do plug_in` | plug_in evse=1, ev=large, soc=80 |  |
| 3 | `do tap` | tap evse=1, token=$card |  |
| 4 | `expect tx_state` | Charging starts | waits up to 20 s |
| 5 | `expect energy_gt` | Energy is flowing | waits up to 20 s |
| 6 | `do v2x` | Start feeding 5 kW back |  |
| 7 | `expect export_gt` | Export energy is flowing | waits up to 20 s |
| 8 | `do wait` | wait seconds=3 |  |
| 9 | `do v2x` | Back to charging |  |
| 10 | `expect tx_state` | expect:tx_state state=Charging | waits up to 10 s |
| 11 | `do stop` | stop |  |
| 12 | `do unplug` | unplug |  |

## Authorization

### `auto_charge`: Auto charge (the vehicle identifies itself)

No card is tapped: the vehicle presents its own id (VID) as soon as it is plugged in and the session starts. Fails if the CSMS refuses that id.

| # | Step | Detail | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `do config` | config key=auto_charge, value=True |  |
| 2 | `do plug_in` | plug_in ev=large |  |
| 3 | `expect tx_state` | Charging starts without a card | waits up to 20 s |
| 4 | `do stop` | stop |  |
| 5 | `do unplug` | unplug |  |

### `smart_plug_remote_start`: Smart plug: remote start without a cable

A smart plug has no cable detection: the connector stays Available until a remote start, goes straight to Charging, and is Available again after the stop. The remote start is simulated here, as if the CSMS had sent it.

| # | Step | Detail | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `do config` | config key=smart_plug, value=True |  |
| 2 | `expect connector_status` | Connector is Available | waits up to 10 s |
| 3 | `do simulate` | simulate action=RequestStartTransaction, payload={'idToken': {'idToken': 'REMOTE1', 'type': 'Central'}, 'remoteStartId': 1, 'evseId': 1} | 1.6: simulate action=RemoteStartTransaction, payload={'idTag': 'REMOTE1', 'connectorId': 1} |
| 4 | `expect tx_state` | Charging starts from the remote start alone | waits up to 20 s |
| 5 | `do stop` | stop |  |
| 6 | `expect connector_status` | Back to Available | waits up to 15 s |

## Protocol

### `all_messages`: Send every station message once

Sends every message a charging station can send (25 in OCPP 2.0.1, 10 in 1.6) and checks the CSMS answers each without a CALLERROR or timeout.

| # | Step | Detail | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `do send` | Send Authorize | only 2.0.1 |
| 2 | `expect send_ok` | CSMS answers Authorize without an error | only 2.0.1 |
| 3 | `do send` | Send BootNotification | only 2.0.1 |
| 4 | `expect send_ok` | CSMS answers BootNotification without an error | only 2.0.1 |

## Step vocabulary

**`do` actions:** `clear`, `config`, `connect`, `disconnect`, `inject`, `plug_in`, `reboot`, `reset`, `send`, `set_ev`, `set_variable`, `simulate`, `stop`, `tap`, `unplug`, `v2x`, `wait`, `wait_message`.

**`expect` checks:** `connector_status`, `energy_gt`, `export_gt`, `faulted`, `message_received`, `message_sent`, `online`, `queue_empty`, `queue_gte`, `response`, `send_ok`, `tap_status`, `tx_state`.
